title: Aurora CFO says 30,000 driverless trucks by 2030 isn't as far-fetched as it sounds | TechCrunch
summary: Instead of Aurora owning the trucks, customers will buy the self-driving trucks and pay Aurora a per-mile subscription fee for the self-driving technology, which the company expects to be about $0.85.
